question: A man's pitch is _____ than child's pitch.
solution:
The correct answer is __**lower**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pitch** is a characteristic of sound that allows the brain to distinguish between a **shrill** sound and a **grave** (deep) sound; it is directly dependent on the **frequency** of the vibration.
 
• A **man's voice** is generally characterized by a **lower pitch** because his **vocal cords** are longer and thicker compared to those of a child or a woman.
 
• In **adult men**, the vocal cords are approximately **17 mm to 25 mm** in length, whereas in **children**, the vocal cords are much shorter, leading to different vibrational properties.
